title: draftProfile
body:
## draftProfile

Keep an ordered straight-edged outline editable as a native Draft Wire, then compose Part extrusion and booleans.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Supply3–256 distinct local XY points in millimetres, omit the repeated closing point, and retain boundary order. Crossings, nonadjacent touches, doubling-back edges and zero area are refused.
- plane selects XY/XZ/YZ; angle rotates about its positive local normal before world origin translation. Extrusion direction remains a world vector. Both boundary windings are supported.
- The native Points and Placement remain editable. This is a batch Part profile, not a constrained Sketcher object or PartDesign Body seed. Curves, holes in one outline, broader Draft drafting and an assembly-history bridge remain missing. See docs/freecad-draft-profiles.md.

Native binding: `Part::FeaturePython`. Output kind: `["profile"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `points` | Ordered local [x,y] vertices in millimetres. Supply3–256 distinct points and omit the repeated closing point. Nonadjacent touching/crossing, adjacent doubling-back and zero area are refused; clockwise and counterclockwise boundaries both work. | `{"type":"array","minItems":3,"maxItems":256,"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":2,"maxItems":2}}` | **required** |
| `plane` | Map local X/Y to XY, XZ or YZ. XZ has normal −Y and YZ has normal +X. The default is XY; Part extrusion direction is a separate world vector. | `{"type":"enum","values":["XY","XZ","YZ"]}` | `"XY"` |
| `origin` | World translation [x,y,z] in millimetres applied after rotating the local outline. The default keeps the profile at the world origin. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `angle` | Rotate about the positive local plane normal in degrees before world translation. Zero leaves local axes aligned to the selected plane; the finite range is ±36000. | `{"type":"number","minimum":-36000,"maximum":36000}` | `0` |
